header.running_head: Occupation with the Ahadeeth of Rasulullaah ﷺ and Befitting Behaviour for those Occupied with this

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA), Hadhrat Anas (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) all use the words "something like that or something similar" when narrating Ahadeeth.

Hadhrat Abu Idrees Khowlaani says, "I noticed that whenever Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) completed narrating Ahadeeth, he would add, 'Rasulullaah ﷺ said that, something similar to that or something resembling that.'" [^1]

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Seereen narrates that whenever Hadhrat Anas bin Maalik (RA) narrated Ahadeeth from Rasulullaah ﷺ, he would end with the words, "It was something like this that Rasulullaah ﷺ said." [^2]

In another narration, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Hadhrat Anas bin Maalik (RA) narrated few Ahadeeth from Rasulullaah ﷺ, but when he did, he would end with the words, "It was something like this that Rasulullaah ﷺ said." [^3]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali says, "There was no companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ more cautious of adding anything to or omitting anything from the Ahadeeth of Rasulullaah ﷺ than Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)." [^4]
Hadhrat Sha'bi says, "I sat in the company of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) for an entire year without hearing him narrate anything from Rasulullaah ﷺ." [^5]
The Dependability of Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA)'s Memory and Narration of Ahadeeth

Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) said, "I have heard many Ahadeeth from Rasulullaah ﷺ which I have memorised. All that prevents me from narrating them is that some of my companions may differ with me in the narration." [^6]

Hadhrat Mutarraf reports that Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) said to him, "O Mutarraf! By Allaah! I am certain that if I chose to do so, I could narrate Ahadeeth from Rasulullaah ﷺ for two days continuously without repeating a single Hadith. However, what makes me reluctant to do so and makes me disapprove of doing such a thing is that although I was there when many Sahabah (RA) of Muhammad ﷺ were there and I also heard what they heard, they confuse the sequence of the words when they narrate." Sometimes, Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) would say, "If I were to narrate to you what Rasulullaah ﷺ said, I am certain that I will be accurate." When he quoted the words of Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) would do so with great certainty and say, "I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say..." [^7]
